name: Are there any contraindications or specific considerations for attending a sound bath?
description: Most people can attend, but those with pacemakers, in early pregnancy, or with sound sensitivities should consult a doctor and inform the instructor.

mainEntity.name: Are there any contraindications or specific considerations for attending a sound bath?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most people can safely attend a sound bath, but there are a few considerations. Individuals with pacemakers, those in the first trimester of pregnancy, or those with certain sound-sensitive conditions might need to consult their doctor beforehand. At Cave Training, we recommend informing your instructor of any health concerns prior to the session so they can provide guidance or suggest alternative positioning. This allows us to ensure the experience is as comfortable and beneficial as possible for everyone.
